div.div:
Request and data flows (solid)
1 Engineer opens the Vercel app · 2 Sign-in through the Cognito hosted UI (authorization code + PKCE, authenticator-app MFA) · 3 The app calls the API with the Cognito ID token (CORS limited to the app origin) · 4 AWS-hosted web assets · 5 CloudFront forwards /api/* over HTTP to a load balancer that accepts only CloudFront origin addresses · 6 Load balancer to the Fargate API · 7 The API verifies tokens against Cognito's signing keys · 8 Sessions, assessments, conversation turns and embeddings in PostgreSQL/pgvector, queried as a non-bypass role under row-level security · 9 Chat (Gemma 3 12B) and embeddings (Titan Text Embeddings V2), both on-demand in us-east-2 · 10 Database credentials · 12–13 SQS to an EventBridge Pipe that starts the ingestion task · 14 The task verifies the NASA archive hash, stores the raw archive and Parquet outputs, and promotes them only if they match committed evidence · 15 The API reads promoted data · 16 OpenTelemetry spans via a CloudWatch agent sidecar · 17 Logs, metrics and alarms
Operator, build and publishing flows (dashed)
11 Operator request · 18 NASA archive download · 19 Image pull · 20 Image build and push (the deploy workflow exists, but an AWS Organizations policy blocks the OIDC role, so images were pushed manually) · 21 Documentation publish. The API and ingestion tasks run in public subnets with public IPs because the design avoids a NAT gateway; security groups admit only the load balancer.
